title: Iran Links Strait of Hormuz Reopening to Lebanon Ceasefire and Oil Waivers
detail: Iran-linked conditions imposed: the Strait of Hormuz will not reopen until a Lebanon ceasefire holds and oil export waivers are issued. This linkage ties the broader Iran-US nuclear deal framework directly to stability in Lebanon, raising the stakes for any ceasefire breakdown.

media.caption: Iran links Strait of Hormuz reopening to Lebanon ceasefire conditions

title: Israel Directs Military to Limit Actions in Lebanon Amid Cautious Posture
detail: Israel directed its military to limit operations in Lebanon as part of a cautious posture, though tensions remain elevated. The directive signals an attempt to avoid escalation while the broader Iran-US diplomatic framework involving Lebanon continues to take shape.

title: Israeli Defense Minister Katz: 'No Restriction' on IDF Soldiers to Act on Threats in Lebanon
detail: Israeli Defense Minister Israel Katz publicly stated there is 'no restriction on Israeli soldiers to act on threats' in Lebanon, undercutting earlier signals of military restraint. The statement creates mixed messaging alongside Israel's directive to limit operations, reflecting internal tension between diplomatic and security postures.

media.caption: Israeli Defense Minister Katz says IDF faces no restrictions in Lebanon despite ceasefire talks
